summary: A hotter than expected September CPI print revived Fed rate-hike odds, driving the S&P 500's worst session since late July as AI and semiconductor stocks sold off while Health Care and Staples led gains. Rising real yields and a firmer dollar pushed gold toward 14-day lows, with bitcoin holding up far better than ether.
tweet: Hot September CPI reignited Fed hike bets, slamming AI/chip stocks and gold while Health Care, Staples, and bonds held firmer.
